name: ChatComposer
description: Mortar chat composer: a labelled, growing textarea with an attach-files icon button and a send icon button; Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line and Enter during IME composition is left alone. Disabled and busy states and optional starter-prompt chips.

props.label: string
props.attachments: ReactNode (for example an AttachmentList above the text)
props.onSelect: (suggestion: string) => void (replaces sending the chosen starter prompt)
props.loading: boolean (a reply is in progress: text stays editable, sending is blocked)

contract.usage: Import { ChatComposer } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Put it under a ChatThread; set loading while a reply streams and disabled when the conversation is closed.
contract.avoid: Do not use it for comments that are reviewed before posting (use CommentComposer, where Ctrl/⌘+Enter submits). Do not copy implementations or override central colours.
contract.accessibility: The textarea has a label (visually hidden by default) and aria-keyshortcuts="Enter". Icon buttons have text names. A busy send button stays focusable. Starter prompts are a named group of buttons.
